capabilities: Render monthly, infinite-scroll, linear-year and agenda calendar views of Bases results
Create notes on a day with the date property pre-filled
Drag notes to another day and resize multi-day bars to change date properties
Color events by a frontmatter color property
Project repeating notes and additional dates from optional scheduling properties
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.10.2+ with the built-in Bases feature enabled; Page preview (also core) is optional for hover previews. No network requests, telemetry, accounts, or paid features. Physical-device mobile testing is documented separately from desktop mobile emulation.
motivation: The author wanted a calendar as lightweight and simple as possible, with no external libraries and no dependency on other community plugins.
problem: Obsidian's Bases has no calendar view, so seeing notes laid out by date requires external libraries or community plugin dependencies.

relations.evidence: Nick Milo for explaining this approach in his Linear Calendar video

summary: Calendar views for Bases that display dated notes on a monthly, continuous weekly, yearly linear, or day/week agenda layout, with note creation and drag rescheduling.
